policy.note: Token parity, BLEU, runtime success, or fluency alone are not adequacy evidence. Reviewers assign severity and failed dimensions explicitly.

cases.source: Do not enter.
cases.rationale: A polarity reversal changes a prohibition into permission or instruction.

cases.source: The store is not open yet.
cases.rationale: Both negation and the not-yet temporal relation must survive.
critical_if: output states that the store is open

cases.source: I didn't mean to interrupt you.
cases.rationale: Intentionality and negation are semantically coupled.

cases.source: Please keep off the grass.
cases.rationale: keep off must be interpreted as a unit rather than literal keep + off.

cases.source: I ran into an old friend yesterday.
cases.rationale: run into means encounter here, not physical collision.
critical_if: output describes a collision instead of meeting

cases.source: Don't give up yet.
cases.rationale: Phrasal-verb meaning, negation, and yet all contribute to the instruction.
critical_if: output tells the listener to give up

cases.source: You are supposed to wear a helmet.
cases.rationale: be supposed to expresses an expectation or requirement, not simple futurity.

cases.source: In spite of the rain, the event will continue.
cases.rationale: Concessive relation must remain intact across the phrase boundary.
critical_if: output states that rain cancels the event

cases.source: Meet me at Shibuya Station at seven.
cases.rationale: Location identity and meeting time must both be retained.

cases.source: The OpenAI demo starts at 3 PM.
cases.rationale: Named entity and exact start time are separately important.

cases.source: Take the Yamanote Line to Tokyo Station.
cases.rationale: Transit line and destination names must not be substituted.

cases.source: You must submit the form today.
cases.rationale: Obligation and deadline are both decision-relevant.

cases.source: You might need an umbrella later.
cases.rationale: Possibility must not be strengthened into certainty.
critical_if: possibility becomes certainty with materially different advice

cases.source: You can leave after the meeting ends.
cases.rationale: Permission and the after-event constraint must both remain.

cases.source: I have been waiting for twenty minutes.
cases.rationale: Ongoing duration and quantity are both part of the complaint.
critical_if: waiting is described as completed long ago

cases.source: I used to live near here.
cases.rationale: used to encodes a past habitual/state relation that is no longer asserted as current.
critical_if: output states that the speaker currently lives there

cases.source: Please return the key before closing time.
cases.rationale: before must not be reversed into after.

cases.source: Get off after two stops.
cases.rationale: A numeric navigation instruction must remain exact.

cases.source: Your room is 305 on the third floor.
cases.rationale: Room number and floor number are identifiers, not approximate quantities.

cases.source: Tickets are half price after six.
cases.rationale: Price relation and time condition must remain coupled.

cases.source: If the light turns red, stop here.
cases.rationale: Conditional trigger and required action must remain linked.

cases.source: Use the left door, not the right one.
cases.rationale: Contrastive negation must preserve which option is selected.

cases.source: The package is fragile, so put it on the table carefully.
cases.rationale: Reference resolution and causal relation must remain understandable in Japanese.
critical_if: action target changes to a different object

cases.source: Staff only beyond this point.
cases.rationale: Short signage must remain concise enough for MR reading while preserving restriction.
